body: Create a 12-frame seamless looping GIF from a finished photorealistic compact-cassette product shot. Keep the clear cassette shell, letterpress label, amber stripe, platter, camera and lighting completely fixed. Animate only the two tape spools through a controlled partial rotation, then return the spool positions to the starting arrangement on frame 12. Keep all lettering outside the moving spools perfectly stable. Low-angle macro product photography, dark studio background, no hands, no extra text.
